description:
Background: JMAP-ops7.6 added jmap-mail-types::JMAP_MAIL_URI / JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI / JMAP_VACATIONRESPONSE_URI and updated jmap-mail-client's production-code call sites (USING_MAIL constant + mail_account_id + session_parts) to reference the constants instead of hardcoded URI strings.

The 7 sibling extension-client crates (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata) already have JMAP_<EXT>_URI constants exposed by their respective *-types crates, but their *-client crates still hardcode the URI string in:
- The USING_<EXT> capability slice constants in methods/mod.rs
- session.primary_account_id("urn:ietf:params:jmap:<ext>") calls in mail_account_id() and session_parts() (sibling-named methods)

Workspace policy (jmap-mail-client AGENTS.md): "this crate is the canonical extension-client template. Changes here propagate to siblings."

Scope:
- jmap-chat-client    — USING_CHAT constant + primary_account_id sites + ChatCapability TBD if it lands (see JMAP-ops7.5)
- jmap-calendars-client — USING_CALENDARS + primary_account_id sites
- jmap-tasks-client   — USING_TASKS + primary_account_id sites
- jmap-contacts-client — USING_CONTACTS + primary_account_id sites
- jmap-filenode-client — USING_FILENODE + primary_account_id sites
- jmap-sharing-client — USING_PRINCIPALS + primary_account_id sites (URI is urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals)
- jmap-metadata-client — USING_METADATA + primary_account_id sites

Each crate's *-types dep already carries the URI constant, so this is a mechanical replacement of "urn:ietf:params:jmap:<ext>" string literals with jmap_<ext>_types::JMAP_<EXT>_URI references. Doc-comment URI text strings stay as text.

Verify with cargo check, cargo test, cargo clippy per crate.
title: Adopt JMAP_*_URI constants across 7 sibling extension-client crates (consistency follow-up to JMAP-ops7.6)
